people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
translations.bsb: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping. “Simon, are you asleep?” He asked. “Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
translations.kjv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
translations.asv: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest thou not watch one hour?
